Restart existing clients to discover new tools and verify model-session tool selection.
Preserve unrelated tracker migration and runtime files.
blockers: No account/device configuration access established for ChatGPT hosted connector, Cursor or separate Grok/Grokbot runtimes. Qwen/Claude user settings exist, but executables are not on PATH; their transports were verified through the configured adapter rather than native CLI sessions.
next_action: Enroll remaining account/device/runtime surfaces through supported authentication, then run live discovery/read probes there and model-session tests. Commit and push reviewed task files and continuity, preserving unrelated tracker changes.
